# Aero Vote Radar

> Built to show where to vote veAERO on Aerodrome (Base) each week. Free, open source (MIT), read-only: no wallet connection, no signatures.

Status as of 2026-10-22T14:31:57.398Z: The weekly veAERO vote has ended: the last vote closed on Oct 21, 22:59 UTC, Aero launched on Oct 22 and the old gauges are switched off, so there is no vote left to suggest. Upgrade veAERO to sAERO at aero.xyz/aero-upgrade. Ranking for sAERO allocation will follow once Aero publishes its contract addresses.

The page (https://aero.deftools.xyz) still previews, for any wallet, what each veAERO lock becomes as sAERO, and keeps the last weekly scan for reference only.

## Links

- [Live page](https://aero.deftools.xyz)
- [Aero upgrade steps](https://aero.xyz/aero-upgrade)
- [Source and method](https://github.com/araxis33/aero-vote-radar)
